info.title: PerfusionGPT — RAG Backend for Perfusion Technology
info.description: Evidence-grounded Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) backend for Perfusion Technology education. Retrieves authoritative information from uploaded medical textbooks, lecture notes, and papers, and synthesizes answers with authentic page-level citations using Groq.

get.description: Check service health and version information.
Check service health and version information.

post.summary: Upload and process one or more PDF documents
post.description:
Ingest PDF documents into the PerfusionGPT knowledge base.
Requires verified user authentication.
Validates file extensions, size incrementally, structure, extracts text with PyMuPDF,
performs structure-aware chunking, generates embeddings, and indexes in FAISS and BM25.

get.description:
Retrieve all registered documents, their identifiers, filenames,
page counts, chunk counts, and processing statuses.
Requires verified user authentication.

get.summary: Get document details and sample passages
get.description:
Retrieve metadata, page counts, OCR flags, and sample chunks for a specific document.
Requires verified user authentication.

delete.summary: Delete a document and exclude all its passages
delete.description:
Remove a document from the active knowledge base, delete its stored file,
and rebuild vector and keyword indices to ensure its passages are completely excluded.
Requires verified user authentication.

post.summary: Search source passages without calling LLM
post.description:
Search relevant passages, document filenames, page numbers, and ranking
metadata without invoking the Groq answer generator.

Enables testing and verifying hybrid retrieval independently of the LLM.

post.summary: Rebuild vector and keyword indices from stored metadata
post.description:
Rebuild FAISS dense vector index and BM25 sparse keyword index from all
currently indexed document chunks. Requires administrative privileges.

post.summary: Ask an evidence-grounded Perfusion Technology question
post.description:
Ask a question grounded in the uploaded Perfusion Technology documents.

Retrieves the most relevant passages using hybrid FAISS and BM25 search,
synthesizes an evidence-grounded answer via Google Gemini (with automatic Groq fallback),
and returns verifiable source citations with 1-based original PDF page numbers.

post.summary: Stream an evidence-grounded Perfusion Technology answer in real time
post.description: Stream tokens in real-time as Server-Sent Events (SSE) for instant UI responsiveness.

post.summary: Transcribe spoken audio recording to text via Groq Whisper
post.description:
Transcribe microphone audio using Groq's official whisper-large-v3-turbo model.
Includes clinical Perfusion Technology terminology priming for high accuracy.

Generate multiple-choice questions on a perfusion topic derived from indexed PDF evidence.

Returns 4 answer choices, the correct option, educational explanation, and citations.
If evidence is insufficient, returns an explicit insufficient evidence notice.

get.description: Returns Supabase & Google configuration for frontend initialization.

post.description:
Dynamically update Supabase / Google OAuth credentials, persist them to .env, and update runtime settings.
Requires administrative privileges.

Verifies a Google ID Token (JWT) sent from the frontend Google Sign-In button.
Calls Google's official tokeninfo endpoint to validate signature, audience, and claims.

get.description:
Retrieve current authenticated user profile from Authorization header.
Validates token against Supabase Auth API, in-memory cache, or signed session store.

post.description: Sync frontend Supabase session to backend, verifying the JWT with Supabase Auth API.
Request password recovery email via Supabase Auth.

Institutional Email and Password login.
Uses Supabase Auth when configured, or local verified database accounts.
NO DEMO ACCOUNTS.
